## About the school
Gurukulam Global School is a school in Krishna Nagar, Mathura, established in 2022. Its tagline is "Nurturing Future Leaders" and it blends Indian values with modern, NEP 2020-aligned education. Today it has 400+ students and 20+ expert teachers, with a 95% success rate.

## Location and directions
The school is at 136, Madhuvan Enclave, Near Natraj Murti, Krishna Nagar, Mathura, Uttar Pradesh 281003. You can find it on Google Maps by searching "Gurukulam Global School Mathura".

## Contact and timings
You can call +91 7505335080 or +91 7617645050, email gurukulamglobalschool@gmail.com, or WhatsApp +917617645050. The office and campus visits are open Mon – Sat · 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM.

## Admissions
Admissions are open for session 2027–28. The process has five steps: 1. Submit Application, 2. Document Verification, 3. Entrance Assessment, 4. Personal Interview, 5. Admission Confirmation. You can apply online from the Admissions page or the "Apply" button on this site.

## Documents required
Documents needed for admission: Birth Certificate (original birth certificate for age verification); Previous Academic Records (last 2 years’ report cards and transfer certificate); Medical Records (immunization records and general health certificate); Passport Photos (recent passport-size photographs); Address Proof (current residential address proof).

## Classes offered
The school offers Pre-Primary: Playgroup (2-3 years), Nursery (3-4 years), Lower Kindergarten (4-5 years), Upper Kindergarten (5-6 years). Primary: Grade 1, Grade 2, Grade 3, Grade 4, Grade 5. Middle: Grade 6, Grade 7, Grade 8. These map to three NEP 2020 stages: Foundational Stage (Nursery – Class 2, Ages 3–8); Preparatory Stage (Classes 3 – 5, Ages 8–11); Middle Stage (Classes 6 – 8, Ages 11–14).

## Foundational Stage
Foundational Stage (Nursery – Class 2, Ages 3–8): The Foundational Stage at Gurukulam Global School is designed for children aged 3-8 years (Nursery to Class 2). This stage focuses on developing foundational literacy and numeracy, cognitive development, and social-emotional growth. Our curriculum follows the National Education Policy 2020 guidelines, emphasizing play-based learning and multilingual education. Approach: Play-based learning approach, Activity-based curriculum, Focus on language development, Development of motor skills, Social-emotional learning. Curriculum Highlights: Language & Literacy (Phonics and letter recognition, Basic reading and writing skills, Storytelling and comprehension); Numeracy (Number recognition and counting, Basic mathematical concepts, Spatial awareness); Life Skills (Personal hygiene and self-care, Social interaction, Environmental awareness).

## Preparatory Stage
Preparatory Stage (Classes 3 – 5, Ages 8–11): The Preparatory Stage (Classes 3-5) builds upon the foundational stage, introducing more structured learning while maintaining an engaging and interactive approach. Students develop critical thinking skills, subject expertise, and confidence through our comprehensive curriculum. Approach: Interactive learning methods, Project-based activities, Experiential learning, Regular assessments. Core Subjects: Languages (English, Hindi, Regional Language); Mathematics (Number System, Basic Algebra, Geometry); Science (Basic Sciences, Environmental Studies, Practical Activities); Social Studies (History, Geography, Civics). Co-Curricular Activities: Sports (Physical Education, Team Sports, Yoga); Arts (Visual Arts, Performing Arts, Music); Life Skills (Leadership Activities, Group Projects, Community Service).

## Middle Stage
Middle Stage (Classes 6 – 8, Ages 11–14): The Middle Stage (Classes 6-8) focuses on developing advanced academic skills, critical thinking, and subject specialization. Students are encouraged to explore their interests while building a strong foundation in core subjects. Our curriculum integrates technology, practical learning, and real-world applications to prepare students for higher education. Approach: Subject specialization, Research-based learning, Technology integration, Practical applications. Academic Programs: Core Subjects (Advanced Mathematics, Sciences (Physics, Chemistry, Biology), Languages (English, Hindi, Third Language), Social Sciences); Special Programs (Computer Science & Coding, Foreign Language Classes, Environmental Studies, Financial Literacy); Skill Development (Critical Thinking, Research Skills, Digital Literacy, Communication Skills). Extra-Curricular Activities: Sports (Team Sports, Individual Sports, Fitness Training); Arts & Culture (Visual Arts, Performing Arts, Cultural Activities); Clubs (Science Club, Coding Club, Literary Club); Leadership (Student Council, Community Service, Mentorship Programs). Assessment & Growth: Continuous Evaluation (Regular Assessments, Project Evaluation, Performance Analysis); Personal Growth (Career Guidance, Personality Development, Life Skills Training); Parent Partnership (Regular PTMs, Progress Reports, Counseling Sessions).

## Curriculum and board
The curriculum follows the National Education Policy 2020 across Foundational, Preparatory and Middle stages, with play-based, experiential and project-based learning, personalized learning and holistic development. For board affiliation details, please call +91 7505335080 or +91 7617645050, email gurukulamglobalschool@gmail.com, or WhatsApp +917617645050.

## Special programs
Specialized programs: Foreign Language Program: Learn global languages and cultures. Our program includes multiple foreign languages taught by expert instructors, preparing students for international opportunities. AI & Programming Lab: State-of-the-art technology lab where students learn artificial intelligence, programming, and computational thinking through hands-on projects. Innovation Hub: A creative space where technology meets imagination. Students work on innovative projects, combining their programming skills with real-world applications.

## Facilities
Campus facilities: Sports Facilities: Olympic-size Swimming Pool, Indoor Sports Complex, Football Ground, Basketball Courts, Cricket Field. Academic Facilities: Modern Classrooms, Science Laboratories, Computer Labs, Library & Resource Center, Smart Learning Spaces. Extra-Curricular: Music Room, Dance Studio, Art & Craft Center, Theater Space, Yoga Center. Student Life: Student Lounge, Cafeteria, Meditation Garden, Activity Rooms, Outdoor Learning Spaces.

## Values, vision and mission
Vision: To be a leading educational institution that empowers students with knowledge, skills, and values to excel in the global arena while staying rooted in Indian culture and traditions. Mission: To provide quality education through innovative teaching methods, foster creativity, critical thinking, and character development in a nurturing environment. Core values: Excellence, Integrity, Growth, Global Mindset, Innovation, Compassion.
